title: Integration Consultant
description:
Job Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Integration Consultant with strong enterprise application integration expertise to support the implementation of Adrenaline HCM and integrate it with various enterprise applications across GCC and other regions.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop and maintain inbound and outbound enterprise integrations.

Integrate HCM with ERP, Finance, Banking, Payroll, WPS and Attendance systems.

Build integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, Web Services, JSON, XML, CSV and SFTP.

Work with middleware and integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), SAP CPI or Azure Integration Services.

Perform data mapping, transformation, validation and migration activities.

Conduct integration testing, troubleshoot issues and provide go-live and post-implementation support.

Prepare technical design documents, interface specifications and integration documentation.

Ensure data security, encryption, access control and integration reliability.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field.

Minimum 5 years of experience in Enterprise Application Integration.

Strong hands-on experience with REST APIs, SOAP APIs and Web Services.

Experience with at least one middleware/integration platform (MuleSoft, Boomi, OIC, SAP CPI, Informatica, etc.).

Strong SQL and database knowledge (Oracle / SQL Server).

Knowledge of Python, Java, C#, JavaScript or PowerShell.

Experience with OAuth 2.0, SAML, certificates and secure file transfers.

Excellent communication, analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Preferred Experience:

Experience integrating HCM/Payroll platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM or PeopleSoft.

GCC experience with WPS, banking and payroll integrations.

ERP integration experience with Oracle, SAP or Microsoft Dynamics.

Exposure to Azure AD / Entra ID and Single Sign-On (SSO).

Experience working with international teams across different time zones.

title: Software Testing Internship
description:
**Company Description**
Code201 Solutions is a healthcare software company focused on developing reliable, user-friendly technology for medical and clinical environments. The team works on solutions that support healthcare professionals in delivering efficient, high-quality patient care. Interns have the opportunity to contribute to products that are directly used in real-world healthcare settings. The company values practical learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement in software quality and performance.
  
**Role Description**
This on-site Software Testing Internship role is based in Tiruvalla. Interns will support the testing team by reviewing requirements, creating and documenting test cases, and executing tests on healthcare software applications. Daily tasks include reporting defects, assisting with test management activities, and working closely with developers to validate fixes and improvements. Interns will help maintain testing documentation, participate in team meetings, and learn best practices in software quality assurance. This internship is designed to provide hands-on experience in a professional environment with mentoring and guidance from experienced team members.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess skills in Test Cases and Test Execution for functional and regression testing.
* Candidates should possess skills in Test Management and Testing processes to support organized and efficient test cycles.
* Candidates should possess foundational skills in Software Development concepts to understand system behavior and workflows.
* Basic knowledge of software testing methodologies and QA tools is beneficial.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills for documenting and reporting issues.
* Ability to work on-site in Tiruvalla and collaborate in a team-based environment.
* Relevant coursework or academic background in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is an advantage.
